name: transcript-ribbon
title: Transcript Ribbon
description: An original animated transcript treatment for turning a voice-led idea into a focused hero moment.
useWhen: You want to introduce a voice, transcription, or thought-capture product with restrained movement.
avoidWhen: The message is long, highly detailed, or must be compared line by line without motion.
responsiveBehavior: The composition stays centered on narrow surfaces, while the ribbon continues past the viewport edge to preserve its sense of flow.
accessibility: Pauses its animated content on hover and keyboard focus.
Uses a stable visual composition when reduced motion is requested.

variants.title: Conversation flow
variants.description: A flowing transcript ribbon with a softly animated voice indicator and a calm editorial headline.
accessibility: Pause animation on hover and focus.
Keep the core message legible without relying on animation.
